summary: Executed requested backend+frontend verification for DebtFollowUp mobile/desktop enhancements. Backend regression passed 8/8, desktop and mobile UI checks passed, hydration showed stable data (12 customers / 12,570), required mobile testids existed, and no fatal console runtime errors were observed.

integration_issues.issue: Multiple net::ERR_ABORTED request failures observed in console logs during route transitions/reloads, but page still rendered correct final hydrated state.

action_items: Optional hardening: reduce noisy aborted background requests during navigation/reload churn.
Optional config cleanup: remove workshop-id hardcoded fallback and rely on strict env fail-fast only.
critical_code_review_comments: DebtFollowUp still uses `process.env.REACT_APP_WORKSHOP_ID || 'finmodule-sync'` fallback in multiple API payloads/queries; this weakens strict env-only configuration discipline.
Responsive split is correctly implemented: mobile list is md:hidden and desktop table is hidden on mobile.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. No DB mutation performed during test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on preview URL with manager PIN login. Desktop showed required controls (Refresh/Select All/Bulk Preview), supplier label became حركة الموردين, and hydration settled to 12 customers with 12,570 total. Mobile viewport (390x844) showed debt-followup-mobile-list, debt-mobile-card-*, debt-mobile-row-settlement-order-*, debt-mobile-row-preview-* with touch-friendly heights (~60.5px) and no horizontal overflow.
rca of the issue: No blocking functional issue reproduced in this scope. Remaining observable behavior is non-fatal network abort noise during route changes/reloads, likely from in-flight request cancellation or browser/edge instrumentation fetch interruption rather than broken DebtFollowUp rendering logic.
